summary: Iteration 4 end-to-end testing of the Client Portal feature. Backend: 35 new tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iter4.py covering portal user CRUD validation (role=client requires valid client_id -> 422; role transitions client<->staff blocked at 400/422; disabled user cannot login -> 403; delete-client cascades to portal users), portal endpoints (/api/portal/overview, /portal/computers/{id}/report/data, /portal/fleet/data, portal docx/odt/pdf export for computer + fleet, portal client-logo access), full staff-API 403 matrix for client token (/computers, /computers/{id}, /dashboard, /alerts, /keys, /clients, /users, /reports/*, /settings/*, /scans/import, /scanner/info), cross-tenant isolation (other client's computer report -> 404, other client's logo -> 404), and staff -> 403 on /api/portal/* (admin tested). All 35 iter4 tests pass; full regression 119/119 across backend_test.py (40) + test_iter2.py (24) + test_iter3.py (20) + test_iter4.py (35). Frontend: Playwright E2E confirms (a) client login redirects to /portal, header shows Temprudence logo + portal-client-logo + 'Acme Dental' name, computers table lists only TT-ENG-WS03 (1 row), (b) staff URLs /computers /scan /alerts /users /settings /clients and / all redirect back to /portal, (c) View report shows branded computer report containing 'client portal copy' and all three export-{docx,odt,pdf}-btn present on both /portal/computers/:id and /portal/summary, (d) admin login lands on dashboard, (e) Clients page portal-users-Acme Dental dialog opens with portal-users-list + name/email/password inputs + submit button; existing portal@acmedental.com row has reset/toggle/delete action buttons; adding a new portal user via the form appears in the list and deleting via the delete button removes it, (f) /users page shows 'CLIENT PORTAL' label for client-role users.

issues: Radix DialogContent is missing Description/aria-describedby (accessibility warning in console); add <DialogDescription> for a11y.

action_items: (Nit, non-blocking) Add DialogDescription inside PortalUsersDialog's DialogContent to resolve Radix a11y console warning.

(Nit) PortalUsersDialog delete/reset actions use window.prompt/confirm which won't trigger inside headless Playwright without a dialog listener - acceptable per spec, but consider moving to a controlled modal for consistency with the rest of the console.
(Carry-over from iter3) server.py is 901 lines (grew by 72 from iter3); recommend splitting into routers before iter5.
critical_code_review_comments: Role guard: client_user requires role=='client' AND client_id present - correct. staff_user forbids client role - correct. require_admin independently checks admin only.
POST /users correctly 422s when role=='client' and client_id missing or invalid; staff creates coerce client_id to None (good).

PATCH /users explicitly blocks role flip between client and staff (both directions) via comparing target.role=='client' vs upd.role=='client' and raising 400. Pydantic UserUpdate.role further restricts role to admin|technician so client->client PATCH role change is impossible.

DELETE /clients/{id} cascades: computers->unassign+site clear, enroll_keys->client_id null, alerts->client_id null, users (role=client) -> delete_many. Verified by test_delete_client_removes_its_portal_users.

Portal endpoints all filter by user['client_id'] via portal_computer helper -> cross-tenant 404 verified. /api/clients/{id}/logo additionally short-circuits to 404 when a client user requests another client's logo (good, avoids leaking existence).

PORTAL_BY constant {'name':'Temprudence Technologies','email':'client portal copy'} drives the 'Prepared by' line via computer_report(by=...). Rendering formats as 'Temprudence Technologies (client portal copy)'. Verified in UI.
Portal fleet/report share computer_report / fleet_report with staff path - DRY. client_logo embedded via same load_client_logo pipeline tested in iter3.
server.py has grown to 901 lines; split into routers (auth/users/keys/clients+logos/portal/reports/alerts/settings/computers) is overdue - carry-over.
PortalLayout fetches /portal/overview once and passes through <Outlet context> - avoids re-fetch on route changes within portal. Good.

Protected component correctly implements XOR between route-portal flag and user.role=='client' and redirects to the correct side; admin flag only applies when portal===false (so /users and /settings still gate for admin).
window.prompt/confirm usage in PortalUsersDialog is acknowledged in the problem statement but is inconsistent with the rest of the shadcn/Dialog based UX.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all requested portal data-testids and flows exercised successfully

Acme Dental client, its logo, demo computers (TT-ENG-WS03/RECEPTION-01/ACCOUNTING-02) and portal@acmedental.com password preserved. context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suites now: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (iter1, 40) + test_iter2.py (iter2, 24) + test_iter3.py (iter3, 20) + test_iter4.py (iter4, 35). Full regression: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml` -> 119 passed in ~33s. Admin can still GET any client's logo (verified indirectly via logo cache in iter3). The Users page renders role 'CLIENT PORTAL' label for client-role rows. Deleting a client cascades to its portal users - verified via login=401 after cascade.
